# Prompts and Project Context

These files provide durable local context for researchers and file-aware assistants.

| File | Purpose | When to Read |
|---|---|---|
| `AI_CONTEXT.md` | Role, workflow, and safety boundaries | First project encounter |
| `CODE_CONVENTIONS.md` | Script, evidence, and logging conventions | Before writing code |
| `CONTEXT_INDEX.md` | Task-oriented file-reading map | At task start |
| `SESSION_START.md` | Detailed session-start examples | After a gap or handoff |
| `00_priming_prompts.md` | Short reminders | During work |
| `KNOWN_PATTERNS.md` | Living patterns, pitfalls, and standards | Before implementation |
| `session_log.md` | Concise index of session decisions and durable artifacts | At a meaningful checkpoint |
| `intellectual_contribution.md` | Human and assistant contribution provenance | After key decisions |

Assistants read these files and the scientific records directly. Do not compile or paste a
second project snapshot. Update durable source files so every collaborator sees the same state.
